description: This file defines the SystemBrandingBlock class for Drupal, which provides a configurable block to display site branding elements such as logo, name, and slogan.

classes.name: SystemBrandingBlock
classes.description: A Drupal block plugin class that displays site branding elements such as logo, name, and slogan, with configurable options and permissions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the block with configuration, plugin ID, plugin definition, and optional theme settings provider.

methods.name: defaultConfiguration
methods.description: Provides default configuration for the block, including toggles for site logo, name, and slogan.

methods.name: blockForm
methods.description: Builds the configuration form for the block, allowing toggling of branding elements based on user permissions.

methods.name: blockSubmit
methods.description: Handles submission of the block configuration form, saving user choices.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the render array for the block, including site logo, name, and slogan based on configuration.

methods.name: getCacheTags
methods.description: Returns cache tags for the block, including site configuration cache tags.
